source.title: Comparison of Efficacy and Safety Profile of Empagliflozin Versus Dapagliflozin as Add on Therapy in Type 2 Diabetic Patients
source.citation: Hussain M, Atif M, Babar M, Akhtar L. J Ayub Med Coll Abbottabad. 2021;33(4):593-597.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Methods says 410 recruited and 280 enrolled; Results and Figure 1 say 410 screened/recruited, 356 enrolled, and 280 randomized.
Results says 76 participants were excluded, while Figure 1 lists exclusion categories n=16, 22, 28, 5, and 10.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: The listed Figure 1 exclusion categories sum to 81, not 76.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Abstract specifies empagliflozin 25 mg and dapagliflozin 10 mg; Methods specifies empagliflozin 10-25 mg and dapagliflozin 5-10 mg daily.
The article defines p<0.05 as statistically significant but calls the between-group body-weight comparison non-significant at p=0.032.
Narrative reports changes -2.9 kg and -1.7 kg; Table 2 reports baseline/week-12 means 82.4 to 79.2 and 81.6 to 80.5.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Differences calculated from Table 2 means are -3.2 kg and -1.1 kg, respectively.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Narrative reports FBG changes -75.6 and -63.5 mg/dL; Table 2 reports 177 to 125.4 and 201.4 to 140 mg/dL.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Differences calculated from Table 2 means are -51.6 and -61.4 mg/dL, respectively.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Narrative reports HbA1c changes -1.7 and -1.2 percentage points; Table 2 reports 9.8 to 7.62 and 8.9 to 7.5.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Differences calculated from Table 2 means are -2.18 and -1.40 percentage points, respectively.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 2 prints empagliflozin week-12 FBG as 125.4±655 mg/dL. The value was preserved as printed and not corrected.
Table 3 reports 15 genital infections among 127 dapagliflozin participants as 7.08%.

Narrative labels 2.34% and 3.1% as urinary and genital infection values, respectively, while Table 3 shows 2.34% genital and 3.1% urinary; the dapagliflozin values are likewise 7.08% genital and 8.66% urinary.
Table 1 reports p=0.82 for baseline age.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Using the displayed means, SDs, and arm sizes in a two-sided Welch t test gives p≈0.000203465. This calculation is an appraisal check, not a replacement source value.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 1 reports p=0.44 for baseline fasting serum glucose.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Using the displayed means, SDs, and arm sizes in a two-sided Welch t test gives p≈0.000211211. This calculation is an appraisal check, not a replacement source value.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 1 reports p=0.62 for baseline HbA1c.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Using the displayed means, SDs, and arm sizes in a two-sided Welch t test gives p≈2.55506e-05. This calculation is an appraisal check, not a replacement source value.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 1 reports p=0.65 for baseline diabetes duration.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Using the displayed means, SDs, and arm sizes in a two-sided Welch t test gives p≈0.0205908. This calculation is an appraisal check, not a replacement source value.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 3 reports p=0.32 for severe hypoglycaemia and states that chi-square tests were used.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Pearson chi-square from the displayed event counts gives p≈0.403153. This calculation is an appraisal check, not a correction of the source.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 3 reports p=0.005 for urinary infection and states that chi-square tests were used.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Pearson chi-square from the displayed event counts gives p≈0.0602872. This calculation is an appraisal check, not a correction of the source.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 3 reports p=0.82 for urgency and states that chi-square tests were used.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Pearson chi-square from the displayed event counts gives p≈0.645141. This calculation is an appraisal check, not a correction of the source.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 3 reports p=0.56 for frequency and states that chi-square tests were used.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Pearson chi-square from the displayed event counts gives p≈0.743365. This calculation is an appraisal check, not a correction of the source.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 3 reports p=0.72 for nocturia and states that chi-square tests were used.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: Pearson chi-square from the displayed event counts gives p≈0.992244. This calculation is an appraisal check, not a correction of the source.

source_integrity_findings.source_finding: Table 2 uses a final p-value column for values interpreted in the Results narrative as between-group comparisons, but the double-dagger footnote says these are differences within group measured at baseline and week 12.
source_integrity_findings.model_check: The table footnote and narrative interpretation do not identify the same comparison. No alternative p-value meaning was inferred.

extraction_limitations: All atoms are model-extracted and remain needs_review; no human verification status was invented.
The paper reports a randomized trial but does not describe allocation concealment, blinding, prospective registration, or a sample-size calculation.
No supplementary file was present in the source packet.
Source-integrity calculations are retained in this validation report and SEA appraisal rather than serialized as reported evidence atoms.
